**Review of the search ad**

- **"The UK's number one tea subscription"**: This is an unprovable superlative (policy section 3 bans "number one" and "the UK's favourite"). It has to come out. Something plain like "A tea subscription from Bristol" would work, since "Founded in Bristol in 2019" is on the allowlist.
- **"Subscribers can pause or cancel any time."**: This matches the allowlist wording exactly. Fine.
- **"Free UK delivery on orders over £25."**: This also matches exactly. Fine.
- **Headline "Tea Subscription UK"**: Plain keyword headline, no claims. Fine.
- Voice and spelling: no banned words, UK spelling, tone is plain. Fine.
- Approval: as with all public content, Sam needs to sign off on the corrected version.

**Verdict:** Do not publish as written. Fix the "number one" claim and resubmit.
